items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: my first break, which was two weeks — it was either a week or two weeks in Lake Tahoe with Racquel Welch.

ctx.x: Did your parents think — what did your parents think of you moving to the other coast?

My mom was all for it. She was the musician in the family and she knew that I had a real passion for it and fortunately she passed her talent on to me. And I think my dad was a little apprehensive. You know, he was a GE engineer guy. And when I first got to L.A. the first year was pretty tough going. I mean some not so fun things happened the first year I was there. But all of that eventually led to kind of my first break, which was two weeks — it was either a week or two weeks in Lake Tahoe with Racquel Welch.…
